capture_method: Headless Chromium (Playwright) fetched the public share page over HTTPS; the conversation was read from the server-rendered react-router turbo-stream payload (`linear_conversation`) that backs the page, in order. Rendered on the local Windows workstation.
notes_limitations: All visible user and assistant text messages are captured in order and verbatim. Non-prose ChatGPT chrome is normalized: reaction badges (U+E200 "message_reaction" … U+E201) render as "[reaction: <emoji>]" and inline search-citation markers render as "[cite: <ref>]"; every other character is unchanged, including the original spelling. Non-text message nodes (tool/plugin output, hidden system prompts, model reasoning recaps) are excluded — tool outputs are redacted by the share page itself. No spelling, punctuation, or wording was corrected.
